entries.name: On Attack / On Crit (+ Wielding: Heavy)

system.description: Once per map, as a Bonus Action, you may heal 2d6 + Mgt HP and restore 1d4 Stn. At 10th level, gain another 1d6 healing on your HP roll. At 20th level, gain another 1d4 on your Stn recovery roll.
For those with nothing better to wear.
Upon defeating an opponent, heal 2d6 HP and recover 2 Stn.

A hefty axe, made especially for military purposes.

Polearmbreaker

As a Bonus Action, push an adjacent unit, moving them 1 square forward. If the targeted unit is not allied to you, you must first pass an Athletics check (DC 3 + target's Bld).

The target must be the same size as the user. If the target is airborne, the user must be able to reach it in melee.
